dedupe_keys.name: servicio de visualizacion wms potencial solar de los edificios en espana

description: Servicio de visualización (WMS) potencial solar de los edificios en España is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servicios.idee.es. Visualization service, WMS, representing solar radiation, average solar radiation calculated for building roofs and average solar radiation calculated for public buildings. Tessellation Display Service (WMTS) representing solar radiation, average solar radiation calculated for building roofs and average solar radiation for public building roofs. Coverage: Spain. The portal shows the English title as "View service (WMS) solar potential of buildings in Spain" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include IDEE, LiDAR, Edificios. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-04-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
